holdout_plan.selection: screen winner fixed before holdout; no adaptive stopping
holdout_plan.criteria: native gate, paired p<.05, p10 and below300k noninferior, CPU<=1.25x

sample_plan.assumption: new policy has similar discordance; predeclare fresh fixed seeds

paired_statistics.note: individual rate intervals are descriptive; paired exact p compares policies; low-score gained means a worse outcome

timing_note: whole-game simulation elapsed time, not overlay latency; short Python tests and periodic report rendering shared the host
limitations: frozen simulator rules, not new live-game validation
monster and tank counts are combat-time proxies, not measured combat seconds
feature distinction is not a guarantee of a correct recommendation
